explain.en: Models downloaded or imported into LM Studio. Imported files may be your only copy, so Hoardless only shows the size. Remove models from LM Studio's My Models page.
explain.zh: 下载或导入到 LM Studio 的模型。导入的文件可能是你唯一的一份，所以这里只显示大小。要删请在 LM Studio 的 My Models 页面里操作。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac (empty); ~/.lmstudio/settings.json downloadsFolder points here. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: The folder can be changed in My Models (downloadsFolder in ~/.lmstudio/settings.json) and the whole home moved via ~/.lmstudio-home-pointer; both read via app_settings (observed locally). Never target ~/.lmstudio: it holds credentials and conversations. No official env var found.
